title: Consolidated Traction Matrix & Sprint Anchors for Private Deployments - Q3
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Create a single consolidated traction matrix and set of sprint anchors that map hypotheses, success metrics, and OKR-aligned milestones for Private/VPC/on-prem initiatives for Q3. Purpose: help PM, Eng, and Design align delivery lanes (canary, cohort, GA) with measurable unit economics and reliability signals so engineering squads can self-serve against clear acceptance gates. Scope: includes feature-level anchors for onboarding UX, private control-plane RBAC, KMS/HSM integrations, upgrade orchestration, and dedicated capacity orchestration. Excludes post-GA support runbooks and per-customer migration plans, which will be separate artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Single traction matrix spreadsheet published with row-per-initiative and columns for hypothesis, leading indicators, SLO targets, cost-per-token target, rollout lane, and required infra changes
Sprint anchors (3 per initiative) authored and reviewed by Eng and Design and linked in the matrix
OKR mapping: each initiative maps to at least one company OKR and contains a primary metric and fallback metric
Stakeholder alignment: sign-off from Security, Infra, and Sales on gating criteria for customer activation
Risk register items captured and prioritized with mitigation owners
milestones: Draft traction matrix ready for PM review - 2025-05-19
Engineering feasibility sync and kernel/infra dependencies cataloged - 2025-05-26
Design review for onboarding and ops UX - 2025-06-02
Finalize anchors and publish plan to execs - 2025-06-16
risks: Integration timelines for customer KMS may slip and block GA lanes
Kernel scheduling changes required for dedicated pools could increase latency risk in short term
Ambiguous rollback criteria between Dedicated and Hosted may cause conflicting routing decisions
